name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires reaching the exit as a primary goal, but no clause makes it happen; FINAL_STATES is empty. Add a hard Existence(at_exit); this will force the agent to reach the exit, while the existing hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) will ensure the box is held at that moment.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) correctly captures the requirement to reach the exit (from the Objective section), ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) correctly captures the requirement to pick up the box on the very next move after it falls, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) correctly captures the requirement to be carrying the box upon reaching the exit.
